singleWriter: The same original creating/admission/debug thread alone calls observeBreakpoint through Scopes::firstBreakpoint.
originalObserverScopeUnchanged: serviceScopes.h still checks startup.wow64 under its original mutex; no callback/decision/identity changes.
rowPublication: Rows at index<count are immutable; writer stores count with release only after all8 DWORDs of that row are complete. Main reads count with acquire before reading exactly that prefix.
noConcurrentFlush: The sole after-loop flush is removed. Only the existing main Release branch invokes the flush once before enqueueing Released; that branch breaks and performs no next control read.
outputHandleLifetime: Configuration occurs while the original state lock is held, before runDebugLoop unlocks; the original Release state lock acquisition orders visibility of the configured immutable handle. Parent closes only its own inherited descriptor copy.
successExitOrdering: Both successful ExitProcess paths require the full Released ACK/terminal CAS, which cannot occur before the main thread completes flush and enqueues that same ACK. Failure exits remain failure and may leave partial/unknown evidence.
memoryBound: 16rows×8DWORD×4bytes=512bytes;15normal rows+reserved overflow. Existing count cap and record layout unchanged.
io: Exactly one existing WriteFile for the acquired prefix. A false result or unequal written/requested byte count returns false, and main takes existing abandon(WriteFailure) before Released is enqueued; no retry or additional I/O.
writeLimit: The whole acquired prefix is required before success. No attestation of later/unobserved rows, durable fsync or whole trace completeness. Disabled/zero-count cases retain original no-I/O path; an enabled empty trace still fails unchanged TS qualification.
productExclusion: debugServiceTest.h is included only in OWNED_PROCESS_TEST_DEBUG_SERVICE; new broker hook is inside that same existing TEST define. The mutually exclusive product branch is unchanged.
firstFailure: The original terminal first-failure CAS is unchanged. An earlier latched failure wins; an incomplete observation write can now become the first TEST failure before any Released success.
